SUMMARY: Prohibition of subliminal, manipulative or deceptive AI techniques causing material distortion of behavior and significant harm
LIMITATIONS: Requires causal link to significant harm

SUMMARY: Prohibition of AI exploiting vulnerabilities due to age, disability or specific socio-economic situation causing significant harm
LIMITATIONS: Requires exploitation of specific vulnerability class

SUMMARY: Prohibition of untargeted facial image scraping from internet/CCTV and real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement
LIMITATIONS: Law enforcement exceptions for targeted victim search, terrorism prevention, and major crimes under strict judicial authorization

SUMMARY: Prohibition of social scoring leading to detrimental or unfavourable treatment in unrelated social contexts or disproportionate treatment
LIMITATIONS: Applies to social behavior evaluation over time

SUMMARY: Prohibition of emotion recognition systems in workplace and educational institutions
LIMITATIONS: Exempt if intended for medical or safety reasons

SUMMARY: Prohibition of biometric categorisation systems deducing race, political opinions, trade union membership, religious beliefs, sex life, or sexual orientation
LIMITATIONS: Excludes lawful law enforcement labelling or filtering of acquired datasets

SUMMARY: Prohibition of generating non-consensual intimate images (NCII) / CSAM (Art. 5(1)(ba), (bb)) and mandatory deepfake transparency labeling (Art. 50(2), (4))
Mandatory technical resilience against adversarial attacks, data poisoning, model poisoning, and evasion for high-risk AI and GPAI
Mandatory mitigation of feedback loops in AI systems that continue to learn after deployment to prevent biased outputs influencing future inputs
LIMITATIONS: Applies specifically to continuously learning AI systems

SUMMARY: Mandatory human oversight design to prevent automation bias (over-reliance) and inclusion of stop button / override capability
LIMITATIONS: Requires competent personnel assigned to oversight

SUMMARY: Classification of AI safety components in critical digital infrastructure, traffic, water, gas, heating, and electricity as high-risk; serious incident reporting for infrastructure disruption
LIMITATIONS: Subject to strict Section 2 conformity assessment

SUMMARY: Special regulatory regime for GPAI models with systemic risks capable of causing cascading failures across Union market or fundamental rights
LIMITATIONS: Triggered at 10^25 FLOPs or Commission designation

SUMMARY: Inclusion of emerging autonomous AI technologies such as 'Agentic AI' under designation category AIH 0401
LIMITATIONS: Framework allows notification scope expansion for autonomous agent architectures
